This destroyed not only the problematic performance changes, but also **all the earlier UI improvements** the user had approved — the hero restructuring, the top-right logo removal, the context integrations, the scroll arrow addition, and the section reordering.

### Phase 5: Continued Performance Tuning and Visual Regressions (~17:30–17:44)

28. The user reported flip card click areas only working at the top. The agent added a separate click layer and fixed initial particle spawn position.
